---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with Swift Save Menus
---

### What happened?

Describe what you expected, what happened, and how to reproduce it. For menu delays, name the menu and estimate the delay and save count.

### Setup

- Swift Save Menus version
- Skyrim edition and exact runtime version
- SKSE version
- Operating system and mod manager
- Save-folder setup, such as profile-local saves or a custom path
- Other save-related mods and whether SKSE Cosave cleanup or backup mode is enabled

### Logs

Follow the [bug reporting guide](https://github.com/andypenno/SwiftSaveMenus/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#reporting-a-bug) to collect `SaveLoadFix.log`, the SKSE log, and a crash report if available. Remove personal paths before attaching the files.
